name: Spatial Rift
description: A black rift floating in the sewer water whose magic makes nearby plants, and later Leighbet's serum recipients, immune to electricity.

timeline.summary: Leighbet opens a grate with stored mana, finds a spatial rift ringed by plants, and survives an eel shock after her canister explodes.
timeline.quote: For a long, long moment, my entire body seizes up and my world goes white.

timeline.summary: Leighbet deduces that contact with the rift made the plants, and over time the fatbergs, immune to electricity and takes samples.
timeline.quote: Contact with the rift must have imbued them with immunity to electrical magic.
